label: Monthly target budget edit console
description: Interactive Omny-style Budget Cockpit editor for building and validating a monthly revenue target scenario.
feedbackAddressed: Frames the feature as a revenue target scenario builder, not an ad spend budget tool.
Shows seller, marketplace, year, and currency as read-only context inherited from the Budget Overview row.
Keeps monthly as the primary input mode, yearly as secondary, and daily as CSV upload only.
Removes weekly input, draft save, editable currency, and K abbreviations.
Makes allocation methods immediate action buttons with Smart highlighted as recommended.
Adds a reactive scenario preview graph with current target and last-year context.
Adds a daily fine-tune modal where pinned day edits redistribute unlocked days while preserving the monthly total.
